notes.title: BRINEMEGEDDON 2.0
notes.content:
While this is a smaller update then the one for GateTail, there has STILL been a bunch of changes and quality of life additions that GREATLY improves the game!

Here are just some of the changes that arrived with this 2.0 update:



- Added a new secret cutscene when beating the game after 100%ing it. (You don't need to 100% the game in one playthrough to activate it.)

- Autosaves now overwrite your SAVE files, removing the possibility of losing progress when dying.

- Changed the song that plays when fighting Criador.

- Added many new difficulties for you to play around with.

- Changed dialogue all over the game.

- Improved menu music.

- Improved first Kittybrine fight music.

- Tweaked some enemies' stats and abilities.

- Added more save cues.

- Improved the catfight.

- Added new characters to Camp Randolf when you complete the game.

- If you die too many times at the catfight, you can get some help.

- Improved the Brineboxes.

- Improved the Ancient Stone section.

- Made the gators in the Jungle of Ice more visible.

- Improved the With Out crystal sequences.

- Improved the PRINE section.

- Many many bug fixes and improvements.

- And MORE.

notes.title: Brinemegeddon-Windows: V:1.25 - The UPDATE Update
notes.content:
- Implemented BRINE BOXES all across the game for new minigames with a side of PREPERATION!

- Added a magical move for nothing.

- Fixed a bug in the dummied fight where damaging it would reset the counter.

- Patched a bug where Bengal was low level on higher difficulties. (He's LV. 73 on all now.)

- Added a new song.
